items.source: When this flag is set to false, the script engine must be specified using setEngineName(String) or setEngineSupplier(Supplier). Using setEngine(ScriptEngine) is not possible because multiple instances of the script engine need to be created lazily (one per thread).
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `false` 时，必须使用 setEngineName(String) 或 setEngineSupplier(Supplier) 来指定脚本引擎。由于需要懒式创建多个脚本引擎实例（每个线程一个），因此无法使用 setEngine(ScriptEngine)。

items.source: When the sharedEngine flag is set to false, you should not specify the script engine with this setter, but with setEngineName(String) or setEngineSupplier(Supplier) since it implies multiple lazy instantiations of the script engine.
items.translation: 当 `sharedEngine` 标志设置为 `false` 时，您不应使用此 setter 指定脚本引擎，而应使用 setEngineName(String) 或 setEngineSupplier(Supplier)，因为这意味着会多次懒加载实例化脚本引擎。

items.source: For example, in order to use a JavaScript library available as a WebJars dependency and a custom "render.js" file, you should call configurer.setScripts("/META-INF/resources/webjars/library/version/library.js", "com/myproject/script/render.js");.
items.translation: 例如，若要使用作为 WebJars 依赖项提供的 JavaScript 库以及自定义的 "render.js" 文件，您应调用configurer.setScripts("/META-INF/resources/webjars/library/version/library.js", "com/myproject/script/render.js");。

items.source: Set the ScriptEngine supplier to use by the view, usually used with setSharedEngine(Boolean) set to false. If renderFunction is specified, the script engine must implement Invocable. You must either define engineSupplier, engine or engineName.

items.source: Set the object where the render function belongs (optional). For example, in order to call Mustache.render(), renderObject should be set to "Mustache" and renderFunction to "render".
items.translation: 设置 render 函数所属的对象（可选）。例如，为了调用Mustache.render()，应将renderObject设置为"Mustache"，将renderFunction设置为"render"。

items.source: When set to false, use thread-local ScriptEngine instances instead of one single shared instance.
items.translation: 当设置为 `false` 时，使用线程本地的 ScriptEngine 实例，而不是单个共享实例。
